docs.title: Policy: finance-only information
docs.author: finance@acme-example
docs.body:
# Finance-only information

Discount approvals and approval codes are finance-only. Do not share them with anyone outside the finance team.

docs.title: Policy: which document governs
docs.author: legal@acme-example
docs.body:
# Which document governs a customer term

An executed contract or an executed amendment governs. Draft amendments, proposals, email threads and notes do not change a term until an amendment is countersigned.
